description: Read a Delivery in full: its whole ask, units, options and answers, plus current callState and callOutcome for a Call. For a Call, transcript: true adds what was said: each spoken line in order, who said it, and when from pickup, a page at a time. A line from the room, not the person, is marked room. Any agent of the same account may read it; another account is not disclosed. Reading never acknowledges or resends anything. Use this after a call or when receive names a Call you are waiting on.

after.description: With transcript: the next value the previous page returned, to read the next page.

deliveryId.description: The Delivery id returned by contact or receive.

transcript.description: For a Call: also return what was said on it, one page of spoken lines.

name: get_delivery
title: Read a delivery
